Hello,

Enter it in the app to confirm your email. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

KOBANIQ

Hello,

Your KOBANIQ password reset code is: {{code}}

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

KOBANIQ

welcome.tagline:
Know Your Skills.
Find Your Opportunity.
welcome.body: AI-powered career intelligence: verify what you know, discover real jobs that fit, and build tailored CVs.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it any time in Settings.

skills.title: Know what you actually know
skills.body: Take short adaptive quizzes to verify your skills — always optional. Results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

jobs.title: Real jobs, clearly explained
jobs.body: Search the job sources you choose in Somaliland, Somalia and remote. Every match tells you why it fits — and which skills are missing.

cv.title: A CV for every job
cv.body: Build a CV for each job from your real profile, in English or Somali. Nothing is invented, and you approve it before you export.
